Cost: 250eb (Expensive)
Shield HP: 15

Fits a weapon's Gun Shield Mount attachment. It works as a Bulletproof Shield (mods and Tech Upgrades included), but only while that weapon is held two-handed and you haven't moved more than 4m/yds on foot this Round. Deploy or retract it as an Action, or while stowing the weapon or setting up a Bipod; deployed, the weapon can't be concealed. A destroyed Gun Shield is gone for good, and fitting a new one takes 1 minute. The weapon can't take Underbarrel attachments, it can't go on Pistols or SMGs, and it counts as Thick Cover against charged Tech Rebuilds.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Rails & Mounts > Gun Shield Mount).
